About the role
Brightwater Medical is looking for an interim senior finance manager to lead the planning cycle for six months.

Your responsibilities
Lead the budget and forecast process for the DACH region
Prepare the monthly management reporting and variance analyses
Partner with the business on investment cases

Requirements
7+ years of experience in FP&A or controlling
Strong knowledge of budgeting and forecasting
Experience with Power BI
Fluent English and German

What we offer
Day rate: 1,100 EUR
Start: 01.10.2026, duration 6 months
Fully remote within Germany
